## E · Error handler
Set as the **error workflow** of A, A1, B, B1 and C: any failed production execution (schedule, webhook, sub-workflow) lands here.

- Every failure is stored in `workflow_errors` (workflow, node, message, execution id).
- One **alert email** to the test alias, at most once per workflow every 30 min (a failing schedule must not drain the SES quota).
- **Drill**: the manual trigger replays a sample error to prove the path end to end.

parameters.query:
-- Store the failure; alert only if this workflow had no error in the last
-- 30 minutes (prev is read from the snapshot BEFORE this insert).
WITH prev AS (
  SELECT max(created_at) AS last_at FROM workflow_errors WHERE workflow = $1
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow, node, message, execution_id)
  VALUES ($1, nullif($2, ''), $3, nullif($4, ''))
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM ins) AS error_id,
       coalesce((SELECT last_at FROM prev) < now() - interval '30 minutes', true) AS should_alert

meta.description: Error workflow of A, A1, B, B1 and C: records every failure in workflow_errors and emails an alert.
